::: {#def-risk-difference}
#### Risk difference

Let:

- $\risk_1$ be the [risk](#def-outcome-risk) of a binary outcome in group 1.
- $\risk_2$ be the risk of the same outcome in group 2.

The **risk difference** of group 1 compared with group 2 is
[@wikipedia_absolute_risk_reduction]

$$\RD \eqdef \risk_1 - \risk_2 \in [-1, 1].$$

Group 2 is the **reference group**.
:::
